policy.equations: Named equation/model entries, not scalar component equations or mathematically disjoint families. Includes frameworks and auxiliary formulations; variants share one entry except the three separately explained SR/GR fluid systems. Biological entries are imported once from their own catalog.
policy.methods: Named numerical methods and building blocks with a reading chapter. Aliases count once; RK stages, dimensions, parameter combinations, mesh layouts and theoretical conditions do not add methods. A family and a separately explained algorithm may both appear. Not a count of mutually exclusive end-to-end solvers.
policy.papers: Unique bibliographic publications classified as journal articles or conference papers, deduplicated by DOI or author/title/year. Includes reviews, translations and explicitly labeled accepted papers; not a claim that every full text was inspected. Books, chapters, reports, preprints and documentation are separate.
policy.references: Unique cataloged works across all publication types. An original publication and a later translation are separate works; duplicate DOI records are not. NASA case links in prose are not catalog records.

items.label: Shallow water, including the rotating linear model
items.scope: Wet 1D flow and linear rotating Fourier symbols; no full geophysical dynamical core.

items.label: Gravitational particle model
items.scope: Static force evaluations and boundary kernels; no coupled self-gravitating fluid evolution.

items.label: Auxiliary hyperbolic diffusion system
items.scope: Periodic first-order steady-solution baseline, not physical-time heat diffusion.

items.label: Special-relativistic hydrodynamics
items.scope: Literature review; no local relativistic solver.

items.label: General-relativistic hydrodynamics
items.scope: Literature review; no local relativistic solver.

items.label: General-relativistic MHD
items.scope: Literature review; no local relativistic solver.

items.label: Relativistic radiation moments / M1
items.scope: Literature review; no local relativistic solver.

items.label: Causal relativistic viscous fluid
items.scope: Literature review; no local relativistic solver.

items.label: Mean-preserving positive-state scaling
items.scope: Reconstruction building block; no full Euler-update positivity guarantee.

items.label: Scalar residual distribution
items.scope: 1D P1 upwind equivalent, not multidimensional Euler RD.

items.label: ALE uniform-state / geometric-conservation model
items.scope: Moving-volume scalar check; no complete ALE Euler solver.

items.label: Legendre modal basis / orthonormal scaling
items.scope: Reference-element tabulation, derivatives, projection and affine mass/stiffness matrices.

items.label: Lagrange nodal basis / GLL collocation
items.scope: Interval cardinal functions, modal transforms, exact versus quadrature mass, and P1/P2 triangle shapes.

items.label: Logistic population growth
items.scope: The linked original is the later 1847 memoir; the 1838 note itself was not audited. The differential equation is not the discrete logistic map.

items.label: Michaelis–Menten and full enzyme kinetics
items.scope: The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct.

items.label: McKendrick age-structured population
items.scope: This is the classical age-transport form; the later von Foerster lineage is acknowledged without treating its date as the first appearance.

items.label: SIR and SEIR compartment models
items.scope: The original general epidemic framework is broader than this SIR specialization. Population-count and fraction conventions give different β definitions.

items.label: Fisher–KPP invasion front
items.scope: Fisher–KPP is a conventional family name; the independent KPP 1937 original remains an archival follow-up. The exact special speed is not the minimal speed.

items.label: Monod growth and chemostat
items.scope: This writes one constant-yield extension of saturation growth, not a universal metabolic model.

items.label: Hodgkin–Huxley membrane dynamics
items.scope: The original squid-axon model is not a calibrated human cardiac model. No single rate parameter set is selected by this survey.

items.label: Turing reaction–diffusion framework
items.scope: A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes.

items.label: FitzHugh–Nagumo excitation and recovery
items.scope: This is a common normalized variant; cubic coefficients, recovery signs and nondimensionalization differ between formulations.

items.label: Keller–Segel chemotaxis
items.scope: This is a common two-field reduction of a more detailed original formulation. Blowup thresholds depend on dimension, domain, boundary and chemical dynamics.

items.label: Gierer–Meinhardt activator–inhibitor
items.scope: Source densities, saturation and baseline production vary across the model family. This simplified formula is not a verbatim transcription of every original variant.

items.label: Fluid–elastic structure and immersed boundaries
items.scope: Immersed boundary is a numerical coupling method, not itself a closed biological constitutive equation. The existing periodic MAC solver does not implement this coupling.

items.label: Chemical master equation and Gillespie SSA
items.scope: The 1977 paper is a foundational SSA reference, not a priority claim for all master equations. SSA is a solver; the reaction network is the model. A seed documents a trajectory, not an ensemble validation.

items.label: Mackey–Glass delayed physiological feedback
items.scope: A scalar initial value alone is insufficient. The delayed ODE is distinct from a spatial reaction–diffusion model.

items.label: Replicator evolutionary game dynamics
items.scope: No universal Lyapunov function or equivalence of fixed point and evolutionarily stable strategy is assumed.

items.label: Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion
items.scope: A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue.

items.label: Shigesada–Kawasaki–Teramoto cross-diffusion
items.scope: The displayed homogeneous-environment reduction omits the original environmental-potential terms. It is not equivalent to two independent scalar diffusion equations.

items.label: Gray–Scott spatial autocatalysis
items.scope: 1983 is the well-mixed CSTR source; Pearson 1993 is the spatial pattern reference. Spot division does not by itself demonstrate cell division or a linear Turing instability.

items.label: Aliev–Panfilov cardiac excitation
items.scope: Monodomain/bidomain tissue models add conductivity tensors and, for bidomain, an extracellular elliptic constraint. They are not automatically included by this two-variable model.

items.label: Repressilator mRNA–protein network
items.scope: The six-variable form is distinct from a reduced three-protein oscillator; oscillations are parameter-dependent.

items.label: Genetic toggle switch
items.scope: Bistability is not guaranteed for arbitrary Hill exponents or production rates. Induction, mRNA dynamics and noise are additional model choices.
